subject: SIG follow-up: supplemental vendor/evidence request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Beth Carter <beth.carter@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: supplemental vendor/evidence request

Hi Beth,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — appreciate you moving the SIG over to the next step. We're working through the questionnaire and there are a few supplemental items your security team asked for that I wanted to follow up on so we can keep the timeline.

Could you provide the following for Aurelia Health (for the SIG team to cross-check):
- A short list of third-party vendors you consider "subprocessors" for PHI/PII and telemetry (cloud infra, analytics/telemetry, support/ticketing, error reporting). For each vendor: vendor name, primary purpose, hosted region (if applicable), and contract renewal/term date.
- Any SOC 2 or ISO reports you can share, or a pointer to where your vendors' reports are stored.
- If you have specific fields in the SIG you want Redwood to expand on (e.g., data flow diagrams, retention durations, encryption details), drop that in your reply so we can prioritize artifacts.

Attached is our current SIG progress export (SIG-progress-answers.pdf) — it's the partial answers we provided to your questionnaire. I can attach a CSV of our subprocessor roster if that helps (we're preparing one).

Target timeline: if you can get the vendor list by end of day Monday (Jul 27), we'll incorporate and return the supplemented SIG and any additional evidence the same week. If your security team needs a specific template for the roster, let me know.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: SIG-progress-answers.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)

From: Beth Carter <beth.carter@aureliahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 13:40:12 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: supplemental vendor/evidence request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — received and appreciate the clarity. I've pulled together a high-level vendor list and attached a short summary (Aurelia_vendors_summary.docx). At a glance the items you asked for are below:

- Cloud infra: Helix Cloud (us-east-1) — primary IaaS, contract renewal 2027-03-01
- Telemetry/analytics: Solara Metrics (EU & US) — retention 90 days, contract renewal 2026-12-15
- Support/ticketing: HelpDeck (US) — support only, no production data stored, contract auto-renews quarterly
- Error/reporting: SentryCorp (US) — error logs include sanitized identifiers, contract renewal 2026-11-30

I've attached the summary; it includes the security contact for each vendor. We can redact anything that is sensitive.

Question for you: do you have a standard schema for the subprocessor roster (CSV fields) or should we just list the columns you suggested? If possible, we need the completed Redwood subprocessor CSV by Wednesday (Jul 29) so our SOC reviewer can reconcile.

Also copying: security-requests@aureliahealth.com — they may have follow-up questions about SOC 2 artifacts.

Best,
Beth Carter
Director, Vendor Security
Aurelia Health
beth.carter@aureliahealth.com

Attachment: Aurelia_vendors_summary.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Beth Carter <beth.carter@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 10:05:44 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: supplemental vendor/evidence request

Hi Beth (and Aurelia Security team),

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the summary — that's perfect. We put together a CSV export of our subprocessors and evidence pointers that should align with what your SOC reviewer needs. You'll find the attached file 'subprocessors_snapshot_20260726.csv' which includes the following columns: vendor_name; purpose; data_types_processed; hosted_region; contract_term_end; soc2_status; encryption_at_rest (Y/N); contact_email.

Quick notes:
- Solara Metrics: we store only aggregated telemetry for model usage (no PHI). We retain usage telemetry for 90 days by default and purge older records.
- Helix Cloud: primary compute, customer data (KV caches) are isolated per-tenant; we can provide control narrative around network segmentation on request.
- HelpDeck: support tickets include user-provided text (may contain sensitive info). We have a support-handling policy and access controls; we can provide a redacted runbook.

Attachments included: subprocessors_snapshot_20260726.csv (CSV, 14 KB).

For process: if Aurelia wants the CSV in a specific format, we can re-export. We also uploaded a copy of our vendor roster and control narratives to the shared folder: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIG-evidence 

Next steps from our side: Karthik (cc'd) will handle any contract/terms questions; Evelyn is available for control walkthroughs if your reviewer requests a live session. If you need a redacted SOC 2 report or additional evidence (e.g., penetration test summary), flag which items are highest priority and we'll queue them.

Thanks,
Hannah
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: subprocessors_snapshot_20260726.csv (CSV, 14 KB)

From: Beth Carter <beth.carter@aureliahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security-requests@aureliahealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 11:03:07 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: supplemental vendor/evidence request

Hannah,

This is great — thanks for the detailed CSV and the drive upload. Our SOC reviewer ran a quick pass and had two small follow-ups: 

1) Can you confirm whether Solara Metrics' EU instances process any identifiers that would be considered PHI under our contracts? From your row it sounds like aggregated only, but the reviewer needs a one-line confirmation on PHI processing (Yes/No).
2) For HelpDeck, can you provide a redacted copy of the support-handling runbook or at least the section describing access controls and retention? We can accept a redacted PDF.

I've attached our internal privacy policy excerpt for context (privacy_policy_redacted.pdf) — it's not sensitive. If you can return the two points above by EOD Thursday (Jul 30), that should keep us on schedule for the SOC reconciliation.

Best regards,
Beth
Director, Vendor Security
Aurelia Health

Attachment: privacy_policy_redacted.pdf (PDF, 32 KB)
